by: companies session, step 4.1 (proposed; the integrator appends it at companies-1)
title: The Companies Office's monthly bulk files as the old estate loaded them, exported once from its tables in four parts

landmarks: gzip of JSON lines; line one is a header with t = export, part, files, runs, aux_rows
every later line has t = entity | director | shareholder | registered_office and nzbn, number, last_file

signals_note: Not a document the Companies Office published: an export of the old estate's nzbn_canonical tables (public.entities, director_roles, shareholder_roles and their history; bulk.*_core_data and bulk.companies_registered_office_address with their vanished rows), made once on 20 October 2026 because the monthly CSVs were deleted after loading. Every row from it is 'taken from the old estate's tables; original not held'.
notes: Two monthly files: companies-2026-07 (loaded 14 July) and companies-2026-08 (16 August, cut about 2 August). The file gives no role or allocation number: the old loader keyed directors on company, names and start, and shareholders on company, holder, shares and status, and folded equal lines (168/172 director lines, 20,725/20,688 shareholder lines). It dated a role's absence from the next file to the import day; that date is not carried. No person's residential address is in any part. Sole traders, partnerships and trading trusts (bulk.unincorporated_entities_core_data) are in the package and not exported.
applies_to: the Companies Office monthly bulk package as loaded by the old estate, July and August 2026
process: Key an entity on its NZBN, else its register number; a role on its company and filed content; the window is the files it was in.
gates: Every export line is a row or a catch-log line.
Each file's line count as the old loader recorded it is its rows plus its folded lines.
The companies live on a quarter end and incorporated each month against the Companies Office's own statistics (check.py).
